address: Grantley Hall, Ripon, HG4 3ET, United Kingdom
bio: Start with drinks and snacks in the elegant drawing room of this sumptuous and luxurious 17th-century house, before continuing through to the beautifully decorated, formal dining area occupying what was once the music room. Shaun Rankin’s creative, highly skilled cooking is a perfect fit for these surroundings and is inspired by his childhood memories and the bounteous local larder, including some ingredients from the surrounding estate. The range of inventive wine pairings and engaging service from the passionate team will enhance the experience....
